Speaker: Player
Text: Tell me about your family in Cheydinhal.
Notes: NEU E35; NHV_Sys_Sanctuary; dauerhaft wiederholbar und unabhaengig von Q00-Q06-Stages. Drei Responses pro Thema; Rueckkehr zum Themenmenue.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: Beneath an abandoned house, we made a home. Above us, respectable people locked their doors and slept.
Notes: xVASynth falls Lucien-Modell vorhanden; sonst E21. Warm mit leiser Ironie; eigene Formulierung.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: We had our quarrels. Put so many accomplished killers under one roof, and even supper requires a little diplomacy.
Notes: Atmosphaerische Erinnerung; keine neue benannte historische Episode.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: I remember their voices more readily than their kills. An inconvenient distinction, after so many years.
Notes: Beherrschte Trauer; keine sentimentale Entschuldigung seiner Taten.

Speaker: Player
Text: What did being a Speaker demand of you?
Notes: Dauerthema 2; kein heutiger Ranganspruch.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: I served on the Black Hand. A Speaker carried the Listener's orders to those who would make them final.
Notes: Rolle in der Oblivion-Aera; nicht vier heutige Speaker erfinden.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: I also watched for talent. A promising murderer does not always recognize a vocation when it first presents itself.
Notes: Rekrutierungsmethode; keine Vanilla-Zeile uebernommen.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: There was ceremony, certainly. But a fine robe is a poor substitute for choosing the right knife.
Notes: Trockene Pointe; Messer als Bild fuer passende Assassinen.

Speaker: Player
Text: How did betrayal reach the Black Hand?
Notes: Dauerthema 3; Oblivion-Ereignisse ohne Gleichsetzung des damaligen Helden mit Skyrim-Spieler.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: Mathieu Bellamont wore our trust as neatly as his robes. He turned our own machinery against us.
Notes: Historischer Verrat; keine neue Verschwoerung.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: I ordered the Purification of Cheydinhal. The traitor survived elsewhere. My family paid for our certainty.
Notes: Lucien traegt Mitverantwortung; keine Behauptung Bellamont sei bei der Purification entkommen.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: Then the Hand condemned me. They were very thorough about the killing. Rather less thorough about the proof.
Notes: Hoefflicher schwarzer Humor; nicht nachtragend gegen die gesamte Familie.

Speaker: Player
Text: What is service like without a living body?
Notes: Dauerthema 4; keine Enzyklopaedie des Void oder neue Regeln fuer Geister.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: Travel is lighter. No provisions, no aching feet. One discovers how much of an assassin's life was spent maintaining the assassin.
Notes: Persoenliche Erfahrung; keine neue Gameplay-Faehigkeit.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: The work still requires attention. Death has not made me careless, and the living remain wonderfully inventive about resisting it.
Notes: Trocken theatralisch; keine Unverwundbarkeitszusage.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: Sithis still has my service. You have my counsel. For the moment, that arrangement suits me.
Notes: Dauerhafter Bewohner laut E35; keine zusaetzliche Follower-Funktion versprochen.

Speaker: Player
Text: What do you expect of this Listener?
Notes: Dauerthema 5; auch nach Q06 gueltig.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: The Night Mother has chosen. I have no appointment to contest and no throne to reclaim.
Notes: Respektiert das Amt; Lucien war Speaker und beansprucht nicht frueher Listener gewesen zu sein.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: I would ask you to know the people carrying out your orders. Especially when those orders concern their own family.
Notes: Rat aus eigener Schuld ohne belehrende Moralpredigt.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: You may find me an attentive adviser. Death has cleared a considerable space in my schedule.
Notes: Keine vorausgesetzte fruehere persoenliche Begegnung.

Speaker: Player
Text: What was Veyra like when you knew her?
Notes: Dauerthema 6; E23-Geheimnis bleibt bestehen.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: Much as you find her now. The same measured voice. The same look when someone wastes her time.
Notes: Unveraenderte Wirkung nur angedeutet; kein goettliches Alter oder Naturbeweis.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: She was a visitor, not one of my assassins. We could work together without pretending otherwise.
Notes: Veyra als externe Helferin; keine fruehere formale Mitgliedschaft und kein Blutsverwandtschaftshinweis.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: I found her reliable. I did not find her particularly eager to be understood.
Notes: Begrenzt Luciens Aussage auf Bekanntschaft und Erfahrung; Herkunft bleibt offen.

Speaker: Player
Text: What holds a family like ours together?
Notes: Dauerthema 7; unabhaengig von Rekrutenzahl und Kampagnenfortschritt.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: Devotion gives us a purpose. Trust lets us sleep among people exceptionally qualified to murder us.
Notes: Duester und der Familie loyal; keine Behauptung alle Mitglieder seien moralisch gut.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: The first is easily proclaimed. The second is built in small acts, and destroyed in rather larger ones.
Notes: Ruhige Fortsetzung der vorigen Response.

Speaker: Lucien
Text: Learn their names, Listener. Preferably while they are still available to answer to them.
Notes: Letzte Response; zurueck zum Themenmenue. Keine Stage- oder Quest-Aktion.
